tei:div.tei:p: ༈ /thugs rje chen po la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor grub gnyis lam bzang zhes bya ba/ na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/ snying rje'i dbang phyug pad dkar 'chang*/ /dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs/ /bsnyen las dngos grub brnyes 'dod na/ /skyabs sems spyi ltar sngon song nas/ hrīḥ gzod nas spros bral 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings/ /gzungs 'dzin 'khrul pa'i mtshan ma las 'das bzhin/ /zung 'jug 'gags med snying rje'i snang cha ni/ /snod bcud thams cad ri bo po tā la/ /drang srong rig 'dzin grub pa'i dga' tshal che/ /tha gru yangs pa'i gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /rin chen bai ḍūrya yi brag ris mdzes/ /dwangs pa'i rol mtsho yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /nor bu'i drwa bas dpyangs pa'i ljon shing sogs/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer nyams dga'i dbus/ /rang nyid gzhi lus 'chi med thod phreng rtsal/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnams/ /mtsho rgyal dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud/ /dar dang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /spyi bor chu skyes nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog dkar gsal mtshan dpe'i 'od zer 'bar/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal sbyar zhing*/ /lhag ma rnam gnyis shel phreng pad dkar bsnams/ /kṛṣṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ /lha rdzas na bza' rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gdan la rol/ /ral pa'i gseb na rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ /dmar po mnyam gzhag bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams/ /de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum yig 'bru las/ /'od 'phros ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur/ hrīḥ stong nyid snying rjer rol pa'i ye shes ni/ /srid zhir mi gnas sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sprin/ /bcom ldan mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/

/'gag med thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs/ hrīḥ tha dad blo yi snang cha zhig gyur pa'i/ /ro gcig gnyug ma'i ngang du phyag bgyi'o/ /rtog tshogs gang shar rang sar grol ba'i dpyid/ /bde stong rol mor 'char ba'i mchod sprin 'bul/ /blo bral 'od gsal gdod ma'i gshis lugs la/ /yid byed mtshan mas bcings pa mthol zhing bshags/ /slob dang mi slob lam gyi spangs rtogs chos/ /ye shes pha rol phyin la rjes yi rang*/ /mi shigs rdo rje nā da'i dbyangs snyan pos/ /bden gnyis chos 'khor rgya mtsho bskor bar bskul/ /'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i thig le ru/ /rdul bral phyag rgya chen por bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dge tshogs 'khor gsum las 'das pa'i/ /zab zhi spros bral dbu ma'i klong du bsngo/ hrīḥ snying rje'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /gang 'dul mos pa'i snang ngor rjes chags gar/ /khyab bdag bla ma 'dren mchog 'khor lo'i mgon/ /sku gsum dbyer med khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag cag snyigs ma lnga yis gzir ba'i 'gro/ /las dang nyon mongs drag po'i mthus non tshe/ /tshad med thugs rje'i phyag gis drangs nas kyang*/ /phan dang bde ba'i gnas su dbugs dbyung mdzod/ /gnas skabs nges 'byung snying rje'i gzhan dbang gis/ /smon 'jug sems bskyed dam bca' mi 'dor zhing*/ /mthar thug lam lnga sa bcu'i them skas la/ /'dzegs te kun mkhyen grong du dkri gyur cig /khyad par 'dir snang nub par gyur pa'i tshe/ /'phags mchog phyag na padmos rjes bzung ste/ /rang snang rnam dag yid 'ong po tā lar/ /grub pa gnyis kyi rtse dga' rol par shog /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ mi phyed dad pas gsol btab bzlas/ /thun mthar dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ /rtse gcig gus pas nye bar bsnyen pa las/ /'phags mchog dgyes pa'i gsang gsum 'od zer sprin/ /gnas bzhi'i 'khor lor smin pa'i byed las kyis/

/sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhi'i ye shes thob/ /sku bzh-i'i go 'bang thob pa'i sa bon bzhag /mthar thug bla ma rang sems dbyer med ngang*/ /snang zhen gdan gsum sgyu ma'i lha skur dag /sgra grags mi shegs nā da'i rol mor rdzogs/ /rtog tshogs 'od gsal dbu mar thim pa las/ /'phags pa'i gsang gsum gsal stong rol par spyod/ /zhes brjod lam khyer 'bral med ngang*/ /rjes thob dran dang shes bzhin pas/ /stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug par/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i thabs la 'bad/ /'di ni bla ma spyan ras gzigs/ /snying dbus bsgom nas gsol btab pas/ /byin rlabs cung zad thob pa las/ /gang shar bcos bsgyur bral bar bkod/ /dge des bdag dang gzhan gyi 'gro/ /thabs shes zung 'brel lam mchog la/ /brten nas goms pa mthar phyin pas/ /sku dang ye shes mchog brnyes shog /sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// //
